Bitdefender is a cybersecurity leader delivering best-in-class threat prevention, detection, and response solutions worldwide. Guardian over millions of consumer, enterprise, and government environments, Bitdefender is one of the industry’s most trusted experts for eliminating threats, protecting privacy, digital identity and data, and enabling cyber resilience. With deep investments in research and development, Bitdefender Labs discovers hundreds of new threats each minute and validates billions of threat queries daily. The company has pioneered breakthrough innovations in antimalware, IoT security, behavioral analytics, and artificial intelligence and its technology is licensed by more than 180 of the world’s most recognized technology brands. Founded in 2001, Bitdefender has customers in 170+ countries with offices around the world. For more information, visit https://www.bitdefender.com
Millions of users worldwide rely on Bitdefender products to protect their digital lives. Behind every release, there is a strong quality mindset ensuring reliability, performance, and security at scale.
We are looking for a Quality Assurance Engineer who treats quality as an engineering discipline, not a checkbox. Someone analytical, structured, automation-driven, proactive, and comfortable owning testing decisions and thinking systemically about product behavior, integration risk, and user-facing impact.
If you enjoy understanding systems deeply, challenging assumptions, and building reliable validation strategies — we’d like to meet you.
 What You’ll Do
Own the quality of services delivered by the Platform Cloud Services team
Design and execute testing strategies with focus on cross-service validation and user-facing behavior
Collaborate closely with Product Owners and Developers to clarify requirements and identify risks early
Create, maintain, and optimize automated test suites (API and service-level focus)
Ensure high regression reliability and stable smoke suites before release
Monitor service stability and proactively identify potential production risks
Investigate production issues and validate fixes with a strong root-cause mindset
Contribute to improving internal QA tools, frameworks, and processes
Maintain clear documentation and traceability in issue tracking and test management systems
Bring a quality-first perspective in design and refinement discussions
 What We’re Looking For
 We’re looking for engineers who combine structured thinking with curiosity and ownership.
 You should
Have experience in QA for cloud/distributed services (API-focused experience is essential)
Understand system architecture and service interactions — not just local component testing
Be comfortable with automation testing and writing maintainable test code
Demonstrate strong analytical and logical thinking
Understand system architecture and service interactions at a high level
Be confident working in Agile environments
Be able to work independently while collaborating effectively across teams
Show attention to detail without losing sight of the big picture
 Technical Experience That Matters
API testing (manual & automated)
Automation frameworks (Node.js / Mocha or similar)
CI/CD integration principles
Linux basics
Issue tracking and test management tools (e.g., JIRA, TestRail or similar)
 What Makes You Stand Out
You think beyond happy paths and actively explore edge cases
You challenge ambiguous requirements instead of working around them
You understand the difference between "did we build what we said" and "does the product work for users"
You improve existing automation instead of just adding new tests
You see testing as an engineering discipline, not a checklist
You care about maintainability, scalability, and long-term quality
You're comfortable owning your testing decisions and explaining them to developers and POs
You leverage modern tools — including AI-assisted development tools — to improve efficiency, generate ideas, analyze logs, refine test coverage, and accelerate delivery while maintaining critical thinking
 We value engineers who use technology intelligently — not blindly.
 What We Offer
Exposure to high-impact cloud services used globally
A technically strong and collaborative engineering team
Opportunities to shape automation frameworks and testing strategy
The freedom to experiment with modern tools and AI-assisted workflows
Continuous learning and development opportunities
